summary.reply:
### Desire Infoweb's Expertise in AI Implementations

Desire Infoweb specializes in delivering cutting-edge AI solutions using **Azure OpenAI**, **Microsoft 365 Copilot Studio**, and **Azure AI Foundry**. Our AI implementations focus on automating workflows, enhancing decision-making, and creating intelligent systems tailored to business needs.

---

#### **Core AI Capabilities**
- **Microsoft 365 Copilot Studio**: Build intelligent agents for workflow automation and conversational experiences.
- **Generative AI**: Automate document creation (e.g., NDAs, agreements) using templates.
- **Computer Vision**: Image recognition, object detection, and defect identification.
- **AI-Powered Predictive Analytics**: Extract data from invoices, contracts, and reports; forecast trends.
- **RAG Systems**: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for AI chatbots connected to private documents.
- **AI Customer Support**: 24/7 chatbots for websites and WhatsApp.

---

#### **Notable AI Projects**
- **Fluentify AI**: Language proficiency assessment using MS Teams, Zoom, and Google Meet recordings.
- **Insurance Chatbot**: Reduced policy verification time from 15–20 minutes to seconds.
- **Social Omni**: AI-driven multi-platform campaign creator, cutting campaign creation time significantly.
- **AI Document Review Specialist**: Built on Google Gemini, it identifies clerical and logical errors in legal documents.
- **Smart Learning Chatbot**: Integrated with Azure-hosted video resources and knowledge bases.

---

#### **Technology Stack**
- **Platforms**: Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, Microsoft 365
- **Tools**: LangChain, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry
- **Integrations**: APIs, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and custom enterprise systems

---

#### **Why Choose Desire Infoweb for AI?**
- **Certified Expertise**: Azure AI Engineer, Power Platform Solutions Architect certifications.
- **Proven Success**: 500+ cloud applications delivered with a 100% on-time delivery rate.
- **Global Reach**: Experience serving clients across Europe, USA, South Africa, and more.

---

For more details, visit our AI services page: [AI Services](https://desireinfoweb.com/services/ai)  
Or book a **free 1-hour consultation** to discuss your AI needs: [Contact Us](https://desireinfoweb.com/contact-us)
